i decided to write my think on it

what happened here ?

in point 1 :

some decision made to break the prior H (barrier)

in point 2:

price failed to return to the source of that DP (exactly point 1) and rally and flaged .

in point 3:

the first time back (FTB) to the source of engulf (point 1 ) formed but
it engulfed by spike south .(a DP to break a barrier ENGULFED in point 3
 )

in point 4 :

price after break the BUFL , flaged and made some new DP .

in point BLUE STAR (sorry i forgot to mark that point with NUM ) :

some decision made to break that DP(point 4 )

in point 5 :

first time back to that DP (source of engulf ) happened and price
dropped and break the prior barrier also (point 1,2,3 made and s/r flip)
 .it's also an independent FTR

in point 6 :

FTR(failure to return to the source of ENG(point 5) and price dropped again .

in point 7:

some decision made to break prior barrier ( LL) and in point 8 the source of that DP engulfed

in point 9 : an FTR formed and price rallied

in point 10 :

some DP made to break prior barrier

in point RED STAR(sorry again ) :

first time back to the source of ENG (point 5 ) formed and for making pools of LQ FO happened

in point 11 :

some decision made to break prior DP(point 10)

in point 12 :

FTB ( first time back to that DP happened and price dropped again
